cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)

project("SecDet")

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core Quick Qml)

set(CMAKE_AUTOMOC ON)

add_subdirectory("UI")

qt_add_executable(SecDet)

target_sources(SecDet PRIVATE src/main.cpp)

set_target_properties(SecDet PROPERTIES WIN32_EXECUTABLE $<NOT:$<CONFIG:Debug>>)
target_link_libraries(SecDet PRIVATE
					Qt6::Core
					Qt6::Quick
					Qt6::Qml)

target_link_libraries(SecDet PRIVATE $<LINK_LIBRARY:WHOLE_ARCHIVE,app_ui>)
# Since the app_ui contains whole lot of not used code generated by MOC
# we have to force linker to link the library as is.
